ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 55:45 ratio of high-intensity (light grey/off-white) pixels on the lateral lobe surfaces to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels concentrated in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central dark pigmentation block extending from the peduncle base into a wide, butterfly-shaped distribution. Light-intensity pixels occupy the outer distal regions of both lobes, with isolated dark mottling clusters near the trailing edge boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped indentation with a deep vertical bounding-box recession; angle at the base of the notch is approximately 30 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration across the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations between 2-10 pixels; more pronounced jagged peaks located at the mid-section of the left lobe and distal tip of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a strong convex curve sweeping upwards to acute distal tips; the leading edge curvature is partially occluded by water splash at the base.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered dark-on-light punctate clusters visible on the distal light-grey regions of both lobes, with a specific grouping on the upper mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical dark linear disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the medial light-grey surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular V-shaped nicks and missing tissue segments along the outer trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant high-intensity specular highlight (glare) on the rightmost distal tip of the right lobe, causing localized loss of pigmentation data.
